faq.page_title: FAQ | Horizon.gh - Transforming the Digital Horizon
faq.page_desc: Frequently asked questions about Horizon gh pricing, timelines, tech stack, international collaboration, maintenance, and our engineering process.
faq.hero_subtitle: Clear answers about our services, timelines, technology, and how we work with teams around the world.

items.q: How much does it cost to develop a platform?
items.a: Our projects start from $500 for professional websites and range from $2,500+ for custom ERP or software platforms, depending on scope, integrations, and technical complexity. Every project receives a clear quote before we start.

items.q: How long does a project take?
items.a: Most projects take between 1 and 3 weeks for websites, and 1–6 months for full platforms, depending on scope. We work in structured sprints so you see measurable progress consistently.

items.q: Do you work with companies outside the United States?
items.a: Yes. Horizon works with teams internationally. We coordinate across time zones and adapt to your communication rhythms so distance never slows delivery.

items.q: Can I hire maintenance after development?
items.a: Yes. We offer ongoing engineering partnerships starting at $50/month to keep your site fast, secure, and up to date. We also offer monthly maintenance, support, updates, and hosting.
React, Astro, NextJS, TypeScript, Python, PostgreSQL, Docker, .NET, Go, and more. We pick the right stack for each project rather than forcing a one-size-fits-all solution.

items.q: Do you offer custom dashboards and reporting?
items.a: Yes — admin dashboards, real-time analytics panels, and operational reporting are core to our custom software and ERP offerings.
We start with a discovery call, define the project scope clearly, design, build in structured milestones, and deliver with full documentation and knowledge transfer.

privacy_policy.seo_desc: Learn how Horizon collects, uses, and protects your personal information. Our privacy policy explains data practices for visitors and clients.
privacy_policy.intro_text: Horizon gh ("Horizon", "we", "us", or "our") operates the website horizon-gh.com. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and protect information when you visit our website or use our services. We are committed to being transparent about our data practices and respecting your privacy.
info_provided_items: Information you submit through our contact forms
Information you provide when scheduling a meeting
use_items: Respond to your inquiries and provide requested information
Schedule and manage meetings and consultations
Understand your project requirements and technical needs
Provide and improve our consulting services
Analyze and improve our website's performance and content
Understand how visitors discover and interact with our website
Protect our website against fraudulent or unauthorized activity
Communicate relevant service updates when appropriate
Comply with applicable legal and regulatory obligations
privacy_policy.analytics_text: We use Google Analytics to understand how visitors interact with our website, measure site performance, and improve content. Google Analytics collects information such as how often you visit, which pages, and how you arrived at our site. Google Analytics may set cookies or collect device information as described in Google's privacy documentation.
privacy_policy.analytics_opt_out: You can learn more about how Google uses data by visiting Google's Privacy Policy or opt out of Google Analytics tracking using the Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on.
privacy_policy.meta_text: Our website may use Meta Pixel to understand how our advertising campaigns perform, measure conversions from our ads, and improve the relevance of our advertising content. Meta may collect or receive data about interactions with our ads and our website. Meta processes this data in accordance with its Data Policy.
privacy_policy.calendly_text: We use Calendly to enable visitors to schedule meetings and manage appointments. When booking a meeting, the following may be processed by Calendly: name, email address, company information, answers to booking form questions, selected date and time, and meeting-related details. Calendly's processing of personal data is governed by its own Privacy Notice.
privacy_policy.calendar_text: Google Calendar and Google Meet may process meeting information necessary to create, schedule, coordinate, and host scheduled meetings and video conferences. Google processes this data as described in the Google Privacy Notice.
privacy_policy.provider_intro: We authorize select service providers to process data on our behalf strictly in order to deliver our website & services effectively:

providers.name: Meta
providers.purpose: Advertising campaign measurement and conversion tracking

privacy_policy.retention_text: For personal information we hold only for as long as is appropriate and reasonably needed to fulfill the purposes described in this policy, and as determined by the following criteria. Retention periods for submitting information respond to inquiries, manage business relationships, retain records for legitimate business interests, ensure compliance with legal and regulatory obligations, resolve disputes or enforce agreements. When personal information is no longer needed, we securely delete or anonymize it.
privacy_policy.security_text: Emergencies provide reasonable precautions to protect your personal information from unauthorized access and misuse. These activities include HTTPS encrypted communications, however limited access to restrict processing data to essential personnel, secure infrastructure through Cloudflare and our hosting provider, careful selection and periodic verification of service partners. No security achieved measures is perfect and no method of data storage is guarantee to be without flaws. We carefully select providers and enforce adherence to applied practices along reasonable technical and business safeguards.
privacy_policy.rights_intro: Depending on where you are located and the applicable laws, you may have certain rights regarding your personal information:
rights_items: Request a report of information we have available about you
Request deletion of your personal information
Object to or restrict certain kinds of processing (where applicable)
Withdraw consent where the processing relies on your consent as the lawful grounds
Request clarification for what decisions and ownership we exercise as set forth in the data
Request export of your personal data into a portable and machine-readable format
privacy_policy.rights_exercise: We aim to honor and apply these when proper to do so-not requiring extra barriers-to move when the applicable law supplies it. To act on your own rights please address attention on privacy@horizon-gh.com. We will verify your identity before acting and respond consistent within the timeframes given within by border of applied law.
privacy_policy.transfers_text: Horizon operates primarily from within Latin America. Some of your service providers (including Google, Calendly, Meta, and Cloudflare) may process data outside of your country of residency. When international transfers occur, we verify the provider has appropriate safeguards in place consistent with the law where the transfers are governed.
privacy_policy.children_text: This and our providing service targeted at persons under 13 years of use. We have no ability or cause to collect or knowingly store personal information from visitors for people under 13 years.
privacy_policy.changes_text: This privacy policy may be revised at times and records, posting here when applicable. When we apply changes, we adjust the recorded updated date right above, and when applicable, we may add other visibility (such as email and a visible notice). Physical visits in usage after we post changes match agreement with the then-available revisions.

cookie_policy.seo_desc: Learn how Horizon uses cookies and similar technologies on our website. Transparent information about necessary, analytics, and advertising cookies.
cookie_policy.what_are_text: Cookies are small text files placed on your device when you visit a website. They are widely used to make websites work efficiently, provide functionality, and provide information to the website owner. Cookies may be set by us ("first-party cookies") or by third-party services we use ("third-party cookies"). Similar technologies such as pixels, tags, and local storage may also be used for comparable purposes.
cookie_policy.manage_text: Most web browsers allow you to control cookies through their settings preferences. You can typically delete cookies already stored on your device and configure your browser to refuse new cookies. Please note that disabling certain categories of cookies may affect how certain features of our website work. For more information about managing cookies in popular browsers, visit your browser's help documentation.
cookie_policy.necessary_intro: These cookies and technologies are essential for the website to function properly. They enable core functionality such as security, session management, and the preferences you select. These cookies do not require consent under many privacy frameworks because the website cannot operate without them.
